opening.argument: Several unusually aggressive signals appear together: a reward of up to 10,000 USDT, the claim that it is “actual real USDT withdrawable,” no KYC, and the ability to repeat the process through multiple accounts. The promotion also describes the reward as “free money” obtained by depositing and meeting a trading-volume goal. Separately, the video points viewers toward material promising profit in bullish, bearish, and sideways markets, including profit “at all times.” Taken together, these are not neutral risk disclosures; they frame crypto participation as an easy route to substantial returns while directing viewers to external links.
